fontoj.noto: The reference public list of Esperanto stop-words (173 words, no translations). Every word of that list is included here.
Words added by this project, mostly prepositions and correlatives missing from the reference list.

vortoj.noto: Makes a correlative indefinite: *kiu ajn* = whoever.
Accusative of *bona*, as in the greeting *bonan tagon*.
Imperative of *bonvoli*, followed by an infinitive.
Archaic and rarely used; *vi* covers both singular and plural.
Used after words of quantity: *glaso da akvo*.
Second half of the *ju ... des* construction.
Elided form of *doktoro*, mostly in poetry and address.
The indefinite preposition, used when no other one fits.
Used in *ju ... des* constructions: the more ... the more.
Introduces a subordinate clause; not to be confused with *kiu*.
The only article. Invariable: no plural, no accusative.
Emphasises the preceding word: *mi mem* = I myself.
A noun, not a numeral: `du milionoj da homoj`.
Reflexive pronoun of the third person.
Elided form of *sinjoro*, mostly in poetry and address.
Proximity particle: *tiu ĉi* = this one, *ĉi tie* = here.
Turns a statement into a yes/no question.
